title: ColorCraft Welcomes Sam Pastorella as Creative Director
summary:
ColorCraft, a leader in custom tradeshow exhibit design and fabrication, has announced the hiring of Sam Pastorella as Creative Director. In this role, Sam will lead the company’s creative vision, guiding design strategy and concept development across custom exhibits, branded environments, and national program accounts.

summary:

title: In Memoriam: Zol Bernard Harvey Jr.
summary:
Zol Bernard Harvey Jr. died February 6, 2026. He was 71. He lived in Las Vegas.

Harvey was born in Texas City, Texas, to Marion Oneta Quarantra and Zol B. Harvey Sr. He was raised in Dickinson, Texas, and moved to Corpus Christi in 1985.
